slices.focus: A late-summer AC failure leaves archive materials damp, triggering salvage triage
slices.summary: An AC failure leaves one archive room damp for a weekend, making tape boxes clammy. Ariana pauses intake, triages affected materials into rebox vs. monitor categories, and plans an incident memo to push for better climate response protocols.
open_loops: Writing a climate-response checklist for future AC failures
Completing the salvage log and incident memo
Determining when to resume normal intake after stabilization
decisions: After a late-summer AC failure left one archive room damp for a weekend, Ariana paused parts of the oral-history intake
Ariana became exhausted and shaken after the humidity scare, feeling angry but vindicated that climate control remained
